scope: Real Godot evidence of two explicit source-painted construction layouts, not a complete random region, all-Seed admission, user style acceptance, market or device validation
raw_byte_preservation: Every listed on-disk original is gzip archived; decompressed bytes and SHA were checked. Missing producer fields are null, never reconstructed. Delivery work is separately owned under ../delivery/.
comparison_limits: v1/v2/v3 changed physical geometry, painting and camera. Images are method/experience comparisons, not same-pixel registered before/after. Layout0 movie remains 97703a8f; layout1 remains ba787df7.
source_commit_policy: source_commit_recorded is copied from a producer header or is null. Equivalent capture commits require exact complete source fingerprint equality and do not alter old headers.
media_limits: Review MP4s are explicitly transcoded copies. Full source movies remain /tmp. All original logs/receipts retain source hashes. Screenshot viewing and selected video-frame inspection occurred; complete playback and actual listening did not.
